risk_note: RV2 (apps/api/src/modules/risk/**, app.module.ts; the withdrawal application and the auto payout decision). FU-DEVICE-USER-ID, plan B (D10-571; identity reviews it on 11-06). Production never writes devices.user_id, and the blocklist match and ⑨ looked devices up by it, so the device dimension of the withdrawal blocklist never matched: a missed block, not a false one. ③a, a direct refusal with 44001, now looks at the device of the request, found by app_id and id; the id comes from the verified token. ⑨, which only sends the withdrawal to manual review, looks at every device of the member's sessions, revoked ones included, no time window, as BR-ID-28's deletion does. 08 does not define the member's device; these readings were put to Jev by the orchestrator and are to be written back to 08. Effect after this change: a member's withdrawal from a blacklisted device is now refused, and a withdrawal by a member who ever used one now goes to manual review. No write to devices.user_id, no change to the login path, no migration, no contract change. devices.user_id is now a dead column: FU-DEVICES-USER-ID-COLUMN, identity. Reading sessions as the worker's connection role is pinned by a rule test against the test connection; production's worker role follows the repository's connection config.
